_comment: Term lists for the lexical scan reported in Section 2 of the BSDO paper.
Fixed BEFORE counting, and deliberately NOT tuned to reproduce any figure
carried in an earlier draft. Two lists are declared per category so that the
result can be read under either, and the sensitivity is visible rather than
hidden in a choice of vocabulary.
NARROW = words that denote the concept itself (nominal / attributive forms).
BROAD  = narrow, plus inflected and verbal forms whose occurrences in an
academic text are frequently authorial ('we identify three
challenges') rather than domain usage. Every occurrence that is
